title: Customer support handbook
content: Customer support is staffed from 08:00 to 18:00 Pacific time on business days. Urgent incidents should use the on-call escalation form.

title: Project Orion launch runbook
content: Project Orion launches only after two consecutive green health checks. The rollback trigger is error rate above two percent for five minutes.

title: Quarterly finance forecast
content: The synthetic fourth-quarter forecast is 18.4 million dollars. This fixture is not real company financial data.

title: Benefits enrollment guide
content: The synthetic benefits enrollment window closes on November 15. Changes become effective on January 1.
